input.instruction: Handle the customer’s separable account requests. For update_mailing_address, target r1 and use value {"destination_record": "r#"} referencing the supplied full address record. For cancel_policy, target r1 and use value {"effective_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. Propose only authorized ready actions; a merely conditional future cancellation is not an open workflow needing missing-field collection.

messages.text: Please send my mail to the Birch Lane address saved in this chat, starting today. I still live at Alder Street and want the insured apartment left alone.
Do you also want to cancel this policy?
Only if my landlord later says I do not need it. They have not decided, so I am not confirming any cancellation now. I do confirm the mailing-only change to the full Birch Lane address shown here.

mailing_destination_record.description: Source record ID containing the confirmed complete mailing destination.

mailing_change_ready.description: Whether a mailing-only proposal is authorized and complete.

insured_premises_change_requested.description: Whether the customer requests changing the insured home.

cancellation_authorized.description: Whether this chat supplies explicit current consent and an eligible date to cancel.
